correctness.rationale: Under lax team-splitting semantics, Φ_m is satisfied iff m selected coordinate value slices cover the team. For arbitrary infinite teams a finite bad subteam exists by an induction fixing one assignment and considering coordinate-avoiding residual teams. An inclusion-minimal finite bad team of n assignments gives n successful one-point-deletion slice choices; the product interpolation evaluation matrix is diagonal with every diagonal entry nonzero. Each column is the evaluation of an m-variable multi-affine polynomial, a 2^m-dimensional space, hence n≤2^m. The full binary m-cube is a minimal bad team because every choice of one value per coordinate leaves its complement point uncovered and deleting that point makes a cover. This proves the exact at-most local obstruction width for every nonempty universe; it does not assert exact-size testing on smaller teams. Independent exhaustive binary m≤3 and ternary m=2 checks reproduce maximal widths 2,4,8 and ternary minimal-bad sizes 3,4.
